overview.problemStatement: The backoffice has a /design-system page and five ad-hoc primitives in backoffice/src/common, but the brief's token table is not a single source of truth: colours are duplicated across .sdrive/product/design-system.md, a hard-coded tokens array in DesignSystemPage.tsx and the @theme block in index.css, and those copies already disagree (#DC2626 vs #C81E1E). Radii are literal class strings, no spacing or elevation scale exists, and about half of the brief's component inventory is missing (searchable select, date/time pickers, tabs, dropdown, tooltip, popover, KPI card, toast, confirm dialog, skeleton, empty state, error state).
overview.proposedSolution: Make backoffice/src/index.css @theme the single token source and expose the same values as a typed TypeScript token module. Migrate the physical-direction utilities in the existing primitives to logical ones. Build the missing primitives in backoffice/src/common with the required states. Document every component and state on the existing /design-system page instead of adding Storybook. Add build-failing checks for token parity and for en/ar/fr locale key parity.
overview.targetAudience: Backoffice engineers and every later feature that builds screens from primitives (BP-007 application shell onwards), with clinic staff as the end users who need a consistent, RTL-correct, accessible interface.
assumptions: Storybook is development-only or not shipped: .sdrive/product/design-system.md section 9 lists it as open, CON-308 requires explicit approval for a documentation library, and CON-302 already names the /design-system page as the demonstration surface. This spec demonstrates every state on /design-system and records Storybook as out of scope; the owner must overturn this at Gate 1 if Storybook is actually required.
#DC2626 is the correct error colour per the brief, so --color-error: #C81E1E in index.css is the stale copy and is corrected.
The accessibility target is WCAG 2.1 AA as stated by the brief and design-system.md section 6, not the [to be confirmed] value in CON-309; amending CON-309 is the owner's action, not this feature's.
Spacing and elevation scales are proposed here from values already used in the codebase because the brief leaves them [to be confirmed].
The marketing site web is out of scope because CON-303 forbids sharing backoffice primitives.
outOfScope: Storybook or any other component-documentation tool (needs CON-308 approval).
The application shell, sidebar, top bar and navigation (BP-007).
Any clinical screen, table, form or flow that consumes these primitives.
Chart wrappers beyond registering design tokens for recharts series colours.
The marketing site web and its component sources (CON-303).
Dark theme, per-clinic theming, brand overrides and colour-scheme switching.

userStories.title: One source of truth for design tokens
userStories.want: every colour, radius, spacing and elevation value to come from one declared token set
userStories.benefit: a design change is one edit instead of a hunt through components

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the backoffice source tree, when I search for a hex colour literal (#rrggbb) under backoffice/src outside index.css and the token module, then no literal remains in a component or page file.

Given the token contract, when I read the index.css @theme block and the typed token module, then both expose the same colour, radius, spacing, elevation and font-family values, and the brief's eleven colour values are present with the brief's exact hex.

Given the backoffice dev server, when I load /design-system, then the token section is rendered from the token module rather than a hard-coded array, and each swatch shows its token name and resolved hex.

userStories.title: RTL-safe and accessible primitives
userStories.want: every primitive to mirror correctly and to be operable by keyboard
userStories.benefit: I can use the product in my own language and without a mouse

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a component file under backoffice/src/common, when I inspect its class names, then no physical-direction utility (ml-*, mr-*, pl-*, pr-*, left-*, right-*, text-left, text-right, rounded-l*, rounded-r*, border-l*, border-r*) is used.
Given the backoffice with dir=rtl on the html element, when I load /design-system, then every showcased component renders mirrored with no overflowing or clipped content and no horizontal scrollbar.
Given a keyboard only, when I tab through /design-system, then every interactive primitive is reachable in DOM order, shows a visible focus indicator, and can be activated with Enter or Space.
Given the Badge primitive, when I render any tone, then the status is conveyed by a text label in addition to colour, so no state is colour-only.

userStories.title: The complete component inventory exists and is documented
userStories.want: the brief's full component set to exist with documented states
userStories.benefit: I build screens from primitives instead of reinventing them

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given backoffice/src/common, when I list the primitives, then the inventory contains Button, Input/Textarea, SearchableSelect, DatePicker, TimePicker, Tabs, Dropdown, Tooltip, Popover, DataTable, KpiCard, Badge, Toast, ConfirmDialog, Skeleton, EmptyState and ErrorState.

Given /design-system, when I load the page, then each inventory component has its own section demonstrating default, hover, focus and disabled states, and the input-like components additionally demonstrate an error state.
Given /design-system at a 375 px viewport, when I load the page, then no component overflows horizontally and the DataTable collapses to a card list.
Given /design-system in each of en, ar and fr, when I change the language, then every label on the page is translated and no key is missing in any locale.

functionalRequirements.text: The system MUST define the design tokens (colour, font family, radius, spacing, elevation) in exactly one declared source of truth, consumed by both CSS and TypeScript.
The token set MUST include the brief's eleven colour values verbatim, the Inter and Noto Sans Arabic font families, a radius scale covering 10-16 px, a spacing scale and an elevation scale.
The existing Button, Input/Field, Badge, Modal and Table primitives MUST be refactored to consume the tokens instead of literal values.

The system MUST add these primitives that do not currently exist: SearchableSelect, DatePicker, TimePicker, Tabs, Dropdown, Tooltip, Popover, KpiCard, Toast, ConfirmDialog, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, and a Textarea variant of the input.
ConfirmDialog MUST be usable, and MUST be used, as the confirmation surface before a destructive action.
The Toast primitive MUST support success, error and information tones, MUST be dismissible, and MUST announce itself to assistive technology.
KpiCard MUST render a label, a value and an optional delta against a comparison period.
DataTable MUST support accessible column sorting and MUST collapse to a card list at the mobile breakpoint rather than scrolling horizontally.
The /design-system page MUST demonstrate every component in the inventory with its required states, replacing the current partial listing.
The date and time pickers MUST format and parse with Intl and respect the active locale, while stored values remain locale-independent.
All new user-facing strings MUST be added to all three locale catalogues.

The 34 hex literals in the five backoffice files that bypass the token block (RegisterPage.tsx, StaffDirectoryPage.tsx, DesignSystemPage.tsx, WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx, common/charts/SampleCharts.tsx) MUST be replaced by token-derived utilities or token references; no flat colour literal may remain in backoffice/src outside the token module and index.css.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: The build MUST fail when a translation key exists in one of the en/ar/fr catalogues and not in the others (CON-304).
Interactive targets MUST be at least 40 by 40 px.
Text MUST meet a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background, and every token pair used for text MUST be verified.
Components MUST satisfy WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard operable, visible focus, correct roles and ARIA attributes, and status never conveyed by colour alone.
Layout MUST be direction-aware: no physical-direction utility in backoffice/src/common (CON-305).
Direction-implying icons such as chevrons and arrows MUST mirror under RTL, while clocks, charts and numerals MUST NOT mirror.
The /design-system route MUST render without horizontal overflow at 375, 768 and 1440 px.
Headings, labels, values and table rows MUST be present in the markup without client state, so static content does not depend on JavaScript-driven interactivity.
Adding a component MUST add no third-party UI library (CON-308); icons stay lucide-react and charts stay recharts.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The TypeScript token module and the @theme block are updated together; the token-parity check fails the build if they drift.

edgeCases.description: A translation key is added to en only.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The locale-parity check fails the build, naming the missing key and locale.

edgeCases.description: SearchableSelect has more options than fit the viewport.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The list scrolls inside a bounded popover, is filtered by typing, and is navigable with Arrow keys and Enter.
It shows a localised no-results row rather than an empty popover.

edgeCases.description: A DatePicker receives an invalid or unparseable date.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: It renders the input in its error state with a localised message and never throws.

edgeCases.description: A DatePicker or TimePicker is used under Arabic.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The displayed format follows the locale while the emitted value stays in a fixed, locale-independent form.

edgeCases.description: Toast renders with several messages at once.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Messages stack in a bounded region, do not overlap interactive content, and each can be dismissed.

edgeCases.description: ConfirmDialog is dismissed with Escape or a backdrop click.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: It closes without invoking the destructive action, and focus returns to the element that opened it.

edgeCases.description: Popover or Tooltip would overflow the viewport edge.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: It repositions to stay in view.
It renders EmptyState instead of a headerless table.

edgeCases.description: DataTable is rendered without a caption or equivalent accessible name.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: It still exposes a name to assistive technology.
It renders without the delta area and with no stray separator.

dependencies.notes: Archived; supplies the pnpm workspace and the backoffice package this feature extends.

dependencies.name: BP-003 API skeleton and CI
dependencies.notes: Archived; supplies lint, typecheck and the CI pipeline, which this feature must keep green.

dependencies.name: lucide-react
dependencies.notes: Already installed in backoffice (CON-307); no third-party UI library is added (CON-308).

dependencies.name: recharts
dependencies.notes: Already installed in backoffice (CON-307); only series colours are tokenised, no wrapper is added.

dependencies.name: Tailwind CSS 4 @theme
dependencies.notes: Already installed via @tailwindcss/vite; becomes the CSS half of the token contract.

risks.description: UI-1 names Storybook, but this spec demonstrates states on the /design-system page instead.
risks.mitigation: The owner confirms or overturns this at Gate 1; if Storybook is required, CON-308 is amended first and this spec takes a v2.

risks.description: CON-309 leaves the accessibility target [to be confirmed] while the brief states WCAG 2.1 AA.
risks.mitigation: This spec follows the brief, claims no level above AA, and leaves the CON-309 amendment to the owner.

risks.description: Token duplication has already caused drift: #DC2626 in the brief and page versus #C81E1E in index.css.
risks.mitigation: AC-001 and AC-002 plus a token-parity check that fails the build when the two declarations diverge.

risks.description: Building fourteen missing primitives invites scope creep into the screens that consume them.
risks.mitigation: Out of Scope names screens and the shell explicitly; /sdrive:review checks that no clinical screen was added.

risks.description: web/src/app/globals.css and backoffice/src/index.css are hand-copied @theme blocks that have already drifted (--color-muted #64707f vs #697586, --color-error #C81E1E vs #DC2626); web tokens are being changed in a separate thread on feature/gate-binding.
risks.mitigation: This feature confines itself to backoffice (CON-303), never merges the two blocks, and records the divergence as a follow-up for whichever feature owns web.
